run_fit_normalizers_cli: run the fit_normalizers script with --config and --out-path arguments to fit dataset normalizers
run_fit_norms_with_linref: run fit_norms with a config, output path, and linear reference file to compute mean and std
fit_normalizers_from_config: fit dataset mean and std from a config file and save normalizers to a checkpoint

review_fit_norms_function: review the fit_norms function to understand how it loads datasets and fits normalizer statistics
